verdict.rationale: Orb is a usage-based billing platform, not an agent or AI host, so acting as an MCP client that plugs in external servers and uses their tools falls outside its product category. The evidence documents only the opposite role: Orb hosts its own MCP server for external agents to call. That server-side evidence does not transfer to this client-side story, and nothing shows Orb ships a client capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
